title: Trail and Current
author: Hazel Okonkwo
blurb: Zephyrine Oyelaran, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
